title: Crispy Chickpea Salad with Tomatoes, Olives & Blue Cheese Dressing

steps.text: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Transfer to a baking sheet pan and pat dry with paper towels. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with Cajun seasoning. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until chickpeas are crisp, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Place on a plate.
Chop chives into small pieces. Add to the plate with the tomatoes.
Thinly slice olives. Add to the plate.
Trim the root end from the romaine hearts, then cut each heart into halves and separate leaves. Divide leaves between plates and set aside.
To serve, top romaine with crispy chickpeas, tomatoes, blue cheese, olives, and chives; drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
